Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.390): (1) No person in this state may manufacture, import, distribute, sell, or offer for sale any assault weapon, except as authorized in this section.
Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.390): (2)(e) The importation of an assault rifle by a person who, at the time of the transaction, maintains a valid concealed pistol license under RCW 9.41.070; or
